//: Recommended MCP servers for web-shader work. Merge the entries you want into your client's MCP config (e.g. Claude Code: `claude mcp add`, or a project .mcp.json; Cursor: .cursor/mcp.json). Verify each server's own README for the latest command and required env/keys.

context7.//: Live, version-accurate docs for Three.js, R3F, and many libraries. Ask the agent to 'use context7' when it needs an API. See https://github.com/upstash/context7

shadertoy.//: Lets the agent search and read Shadertoy to learn from and generate GLSL. See https://github.com/wilsonchenghy/ShaderToy-MCP (requires a Shadertoy API key; follow its README).
